ArtifactRef.description:
A content-addressed artifact in a session tree's store: a user upload, a
tool attachment, or the full content of a truncated display block.

filename.description: The name the file was attached under, without a directory.

media_type.description: The media type sniffed from the content, such as `image/png`.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

UserContent.description: A user's input: a nonempty list of parts.

UserContentPart.description: One part of a user's input.

description:
What `session.recall_input` did. A client reads it open: an outcome it
does not know fails the call with [`crate::ClientError::UnknownOutcome`].

oneOf.description: The input was withdrawn; its content is returned for editing.

The input is no longer pending or queued: the model already saw it,
a run started with it, or it was voided.

Another client submitted the input; only its author can recall it.
A daemon before client protocol 1.31.0 answers it; later ones let
any client recall any waiting input.

title: SessionRecallInputResult
